subject.title: Feature request: opt-in per-domain credential pass-through for web_fetch/image tools

question: Should exact-host credential use be added to shared model-facing fetch infrastructure, or remain provider/plugin-owned through a narrow authenticated retrieval tool or host service?
rationale: The choice determines which model-influenced URLs can trigger secret transmission and requires intentional policy for redirects, caching, sandboxing, redaction, configuration, and plugin compatibility.

options.title: Provider/plugin-owned service
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated retrieval tool or restricted host service controlled by the component that owns the credential.

options.title: Shared generic policy
options.body: Add exact-host SecretRef mappings to web_fetch and image with uniform redirect, cache, redaction, and sandbox rules.

options.title: Keep explicit workflow
options.body: Retain authenticated download to a local file and improve documentation without expanding generic tool authority.

recommendation.title: Provider/plugin-owned service
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated retrieval tool or restricted host service controlled by the component that owns the credential.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans the relevant agent image, SSRF, and web credential boundaries, making this the strongest available cross-cutting decision owner.
